answer: Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. A farm that mints names by the dozen still pays the toll name by name, and the tundra proves it. Trying costs 7 letters of reference, each one priced at £38 a name, and the money is gone whether the name passes or fails. A seat is earned, not claimed: Saltstorebound salt yard keeper pan licence makes sure of that, since a licence salt yard keepers carry after salt yard trials. The tally keeps anchor. The plume is on the docket.
